project_name: Diagrams as Code - Directed IIoT Engine

can_render_without_graphviz.details: Renders high-fidelity SVG diagrams directly using pure Python standard library string formatting without external Graphviz, Cairo, or binary dependencies.

can_position_shapes_relatively.details: Directional placement (right_of, left_of, below, above) with margin padding and alignment constraints resolved via iterative topological DAG solver.

can_position_shapes_with_unit_basis.details: Normalized coordinate placement across 0.0-1.0 unit-basis or percentage strings ('50%', '25%') mapped to canvas dimensions.

can_decouple_shape_definition_from_locat.details: Complete decoupling of shape instantiation, existence, and spatial placement. Shapes can be defined unplaced, placed late, relocated, or cloned from prototypes.

can_generate_living_bom_documentation.details: Extracts diagram inventory, group affiliations, connection topology, and technical metadata into Markdown tables and JSON catalogs.

capabilities.name: Core Geometry and Unit-Basis Coordinate Engine
capabilities.details: Immutable 2D geometric primitives, 9-point cardinal/intercardinal rect anchors, rect expansion/union, and normalized canvas unit-basis coordinate conversion.

capabilities.name: Decoupled Elements and Iterative DAG Constraint Solver
capabilities.details: Directed shape-to-shape relative positioning (right_of, left_of, below, above) with alignment and margin padding. Evaluates dependency DAGs with cycle detection and unconstrained element retention.

capabilities.name: Hierarchical Grouping, Auto-Bounding, and Group Flow
capabilities.details: Hierarchical container elements with bottom-up recursive auto-bounding, child coordinate delta propagation, cycle prevention, and group-to-group flow placement.

capabilities.name: Orthogonal Manhattan Routing and Port Deduction
capabilities.details: Intelligent edge connection model with automatic port deduction (North, South, East, West), orthogonal Manhattan waypoints calculation, and collinear straight-line simplification.

capabilities.name: Vector Theming Engine and Vector Shape Library
capabilities.details: Immutable theme presets (iiot_dark_gold, iiot_light, blueprint, cyber_slate) and standalone SVG vector primitives (box, cylinder, database, server_rack, cloud, diamond, badge) with built-in IIoT vector icons.

capabilities.name: Pure-Python Zero-Binary SVG Vector Renderer
capabilities.details: Produces valid, standalone W3C SVG XML documents featuring responsive viewBox scaling, arrowhead markers, drop shadow filters, ordered group rendering, and automated luminance contrast text coloring.

capabilities.name: Fluent Diagram Context Manager and Operator Syntax
capabilities.details: Pythonic context manager with bitshift connection operator overloading (s1 >> s2, s1 >> diag.edge(...) >> s2, fan-in/fan-out lists), automatic group scoping, decoupled shape lifecycles, and prototype cloning.

capabilities.name: Living Documentation & Bill of Materials (BOM) Engine
capabilities.details: Extracts diagram inventory, parent groups, connection routes, and technical metadata into Markdown tables and JSON catalogs, with automated README.md synchronization.

capabilities.name: Interactive SVG Pan-Zoom and Collapsible Groups
capabilities.details: Client-side lightweight JavaScript injection into SVG output for interactive panning, zooming, and group fold/unfold toggles.
